subject: Order form: finalize audit-rights runway & evidence rhythm
messages:
From: Helen Park <hpark@elysianhealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@elysianhealth.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form questions — SOC2 excerpt & pen-test timing

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the draft order form. Before procurement can move this forward we need a little more specificity on the security exhibit:

- Can you confirm the SOC 2 report date and whether Redwood will provide a scoped excerpt that references hosting and production controls?
- For the pen-test language, our security team needs a bounded window (start/end), minimum notice, and a list of permitted test types (no social engineering).
- We also need to understand evidence cadence: how often applicable artifacts (e.g., pen-test reports, control attestations, and log retention details) will be provided to Elysian.

Attaching the order form we received from your AE with our redline annotations. Happy to hop on a quick call to align.

Thanks,
Helen
Chief Information Security Officer
Elysian Health

Attachment: Elysian_ORDERFORM_v2.pdf (order form with annotated comments)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Helen Park <hpark@elysianhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, procurement@elysianhealth.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form questions — SOC2 excerpt & pen-test timing

Hi Helen — thanks for the clear list. I've looped in Laura (legal), Karthik (security) and Neha (GTM/legal liaison) so we can address each ask. Quick answers and a proposed runway: 

1) SOC 2: Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report is dated 2027-06; we can provide a certified excerpt that highlights the production environment controls and the scope of systems in-scope. Proposed delivery: within 3 business days after countersignature (we'll attach SOC2_report_excerpt.pdf).

2) Pen-test language: we can accept time-boxed inspection language instead of broad 'inspection rights' — propose a single 5-business-day window per 12-month period, with at least 10 business days' notice. Also propose explicit exclusion for social engineering and physical penetration tests.

3) Evidence cadence: propose quarterly security summary (high-level) and annual detailed artifacts (SOC 2 + pen-test report) delivered via secure link. For incident-driven requests, we'll follow the escalation and NDAs already in the MSA and will provide supported evidence within agreed SLAs.

I've attached a redline (redlines_markus_v1.docx) with the language we recommend for the order form and security exhibit. If that aligns, Laura will prepare final legal wording. If you prefer a different notice/window, let us know and we'll adjust.

Best,
Markus Klein
VP, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines_markus_v1.docx; SOC2_report_excerpt.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, Helen Park <hpark@elysianhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form questions — SOC2 excerpt & pen-test timing

Hi all — commenting on the proposed language and a few negotiation guardrails. I'm pasting the key redline suggestions below for clarity; full tracked changes are in the attached docx.

- Audit Rights / Inspection Window: Replace open-ended inspection clause with: 
  "Customer may request up to one (1) inspection window per twelve (12) month period, up to five (5) consecutive business days, with at least ten (10) business days' prior written notice. Redwood shall not be required to provide access that materially disrupts production."

- Scope & Minimization: Limit inspection scope to systems and logs reasonably necessary to validate the relevant control assertions for services purchased. Redwood will provide sampled evidence where full access would expose other customers' data.

- Pen-Test Language: Accept customer-conducted penetration tests subject to: (i) mutually agreed scope and rules of engagement, (ii) executed test authorization, (iii) exclusion of social engineering and denial-of-service as test types, and (iv) requirement to route coordination through Redwood security for safety. Add a clause requiring proof of insurance from external testers (if customer uses a third-party vendor).

- Evidence Cadence & Delivery: Suggest: quarterly security summary (operational posture + notable findings), annual SOC 2 (or bridge letter) and single aggregated pen-test report after the annual test. For production logs, provide retention matrix (we'll include retention periods and aggregation level in the exhibit).

- Redlines for emergency/incident requests: define 'incident' carve-out with a 24-hour acknowledgement and a 5-business-day target for targeted artifact delivery, subject to redaction to remove other customers' data.

Next steps I propose: Mark a 30-minute alignment call Thursday to walk through the language and confirm the inspection window and notice period. If Elysian accepts the 1x/12mo, 5-day window and 10-day notice, I can incorporate exact language and produce a final doc for countersignature.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Legal — Contracts & Compliance

Attachment: redlines_markus_v1.docx (tracked changes from counsel)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Helen Park <hpark@elysianhealth.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form questions — SOC2 excerpt & pen-test timing

Hi Helen and team — technical ack and a couple of operational notes from security: 

- Pen-test logistics: If Elysian prefers Redwood to observe or accept a customer-run test, we'll require pre-test artifact exchange (target IP ranges, test types, test hours) and a short runbook on rollback/containment. For any tests that would involve staging, we'll provide a staging environment access plan; production tests will be strictly limited to the agreed scope.

- Evidence delivery: we'll publish the quarterly security summary to a secure share (we recommend a read-only S3 link with short-lived tokens). Annual reports (SOC2, aggregated pen-test) will be delivered as encrypted PDFs via the same channel.

- Log retention: Redwood retains request logs and audit trails for eighteen (18) months by default; we can extend per contract for an additional retention fee. We'll include a retention matrix in the final exhibit.

- On testing frequency: we prefer a single ordered annual test to balance risk and customer impact. If Elysian needs an additional window, we suggest limiting to one ad-hoc test per 12 months and requiring 20 business days' prior coordination if more than one test is requested.

Happy to run a quick technical sync with your security team next week if helpful.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security Operations — Redwood Inference

P.S. Laura: I'm comfortable with the 5-business-day window + 10-day notice language; it aligns with our runbooks.
